name: Feedliyo – Social Feed & Product Feed Lite
author: feedliyo

sections.description:
Feedliyo is the all-in-one social feed and WooCommerce product catalog plugin for WordPress.

Show Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), and Threads galleries on your site — and generate WooCommerce product feed / catalog files for Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Commerce and TikTok Catalog — from one admin, one builder, and one brand.

Stop installing a separate Instagram feed plugin, Facebook feed plugin, TikTok feed plugin, YouTube feed plugin, and Twitter/X feed plugin. Feedliyo Lite replaces that stack with a single multi-network social feed + product catalog workflow built for stores and marketers.

Live demos

See each social feed on a real site:

  • Instagram feed demo
  • Facebook feed demo
  • TikTok feed demo
  • X feed demo
  • YouTube feed demo
  • Threads feed demo
  • Social Wall demo (Pro — multi-account masonry wall)

Why Feedliyo (our USPs)

  • All-in-one social feed — Instagram feed, Facebook feed, TikTok feed, YouTube feed, X feed, and Threads feed in one WordPress plugin
  • Social feed + product feed together — on-site UGC galleries and WooCommerce catalogs for ads in the same product
  • WooCommerce-ready catalogs — export products as a Meta / Instagram catalog (XML) and TikTok product catalog (CSV) with a secret public URL
  • Official APIs only — Meta Graph, Instagram, Threads, TikTok Display, YouTube Data API / RSS, X API v2. No scraping
  • Embed anywhere — shortcode, Gutenberg block, and Elementor widget for every channel
  • Unlimited accounts — connect as many Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Threads accounts as you need on Free
  • Lightbox included — open posts in a full lightbox on Free (no Pro required)
  • Store-friendly builder — connect Social Accounts → Feed wizard → Feed builder → paste shortcode or drop a block
  • Privacy-aware — encrypted tokens; optional advertising pixels stay off until you configure them (Pro); GDPR mode available
  • Pro upgrade path — keep Lite installed; unlock advanced layouts, Social Walls, shoppable tags, more catalogs, pixels, and Import / Export with Feedliyo Pro

Free in Feedliyo Lite

  • 6 social platforms: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, Threads
  • Unlimited accounts — no account caps on Free or Pro
  • Lightbox — click any post to open a full lightbox gallery
  • Grid social gallery layout with header, Follow, captions, and Load more
  • Feed wizard + Feed builder (Account · Layout · Customize · Display)
  • Social Accounts connect flow (OAuth bridge or paste tokens)
  • Embed with [fspf_feed id=""], Gutenberg blocks, and Elementor widgets
  • WooCommerce product catalogs for Meta / Instagram and TikTok
  • Catalog controls: product ID (SKU or Woo ID), descriptions, brand, variations, OOS exclude, schedule, secret URL, download
  • Built-in How To guides for Social Feed and Product Feed
  • Cache, Sync now, cron refresh, and health emails on failures

Product catalogs (WooCommerce → ads)

Create a product feed from WooCommerce and host it on your site:

  • Meta / Instagram Commerce Manager — RSS XML catalog (g: product fields)
  • TikTok Catalog — CSV product feed with catalog-aligned IDs

Paste the secret Catalog URL into Meta Commerce Manager or TikTok Ads. No Google Shopping support (by design — Feedliyo focuses on social commerce channels).

How it works

  1. Install and activate Feedliyo – Social Feed & Product Feed Lite
  2. Open Feedliyo in the WordPress admin
  3. Connect Social Accounts (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, Threads)
  4. Add New Feed — pick platform, account, and Grid layout, then copy the shortcode / block
  5. Optional: create a Catalog from WooCommerce for Meta or TikTok and paste the URL into ads
  6. Style with Appearance → Customize → Additional CSS (the plugin does not store arbitrary CSS or JavaScript)

Perfect for

  • WooCommerce stores that want an Instagram feed and a TikTok feed without five extra plugins
  • Brands that need a Facebook Page feed, YouTube gallery, X / Twitter feed, or Threads feed on WordPress
  • Marketers who need a WooCommerce product catalog for Meta ads and TikTok ads
  • Agencies consolidating social media feed tools into one stack

Upgrade to Feedliyo Pro (optional add-on)

Pro requires Lite and unlocks:

  • Advanced feed layouts: List, Masonry, Carousel, Highlight, Playlist, Stories, Combined wall
  • Social Walls (multi-account / multi-network masonry wall) — see the Social Wall demo
  • Likes, comments & filter tabs; post moderation; hashtag feeds
  • Shoppable tags for WooCommerce (pin products, Buy now)
  • Extra catalogs: Pinterest & Snapchat + social-only catalog filters
  • Meta Pixel / Conversion API and TikTok Pixel / Events API
  • Import / Export backups for feeds, accounts, catalogs, and walls
  • Priority support

Keep Lite installed — Pro is an add-on, not a replacement.

Get Feedliyo Pro: https://feedliyo.com/

Privacy & compliance notes

  • Social feeds load your connected accounts via official APIs
  • Catalog files are generated on your WordPress site
  • Advertising pixels are optional and Pro-oriented; GDPR mode can pause them until consent allows them
  • YouTube lightbox can use youtube-nocookie.com after click

External services

This plugin connects to third-party APIs so it can load your social posts, refresh tokens, generate catalog files you host, and (only if you enable them) send advertising events. No requests are made until you connect an account or save a pixel ID. Below is what is sent, when, and the provider terms.

Meta Graph API (Facebook and Instagram)

Used to list Pages, load Facebook Page posts and Instagram media, refresh tokens, and optionally import Instagram product tags.

Data sent when you connect an account or when a feed refreshes (cron or admin): your access token, and the Page or Instagram account IDs you connected. The site URL is included in the WordPress HTTP user-agent.

Service: Meta Platforms. Terms · Privacy Policy · Developer Terms

Instagram API

Used with Instagram Login or Facebook Graph tokens to load profile and media.

Data sent on connect and refresh: access token and Instagram user ID.

Service: Meta / Instagram. Terms · Privacy Policy

Threads API

Used to load Threads profile and posts.

Data sent on connect and refresh: access token and Threads user ID.

Service: Meta / Threads. Terms · Privacy Policy

TikTok Display API

Used to load TikTok profile and videos, and to refresh tokens if you save a TikTok client key and secret.

Data sent on connect, refresh, and token renewal: access token, refresh token (when stored), and TikTok open_id / client key as required by TikTok’s token endpoint.

Service: TikTok. Terms of Service · Privacy Policy · Developer Terms

YouTube Data API and YouTube RSS

Used to resolve channel IDs (when you save a Google API key) and to list public videos. If no API key is saved, public UC channel IDs use YouTube’s videos RSS. The lightbox embeds youtube-nocookie.com only after a visitor clicks.

Data sent: your YouTube Data API key (if saved), channel or playlist IDs. RSS requests send the channel ID only.

Service: Google / YouTube. YouTube API Terms · Google Privacy Policy · YouTube Terms

X API v2

Used to load posts for an X username when you provide a bearer token.

Data sent on refresh: bearer token and the username you connected.

Service: X Corp. Terms of Service · Privacy Policy · Developer Agreement

Meta Pixel and Conversion API (optional)

Used only if you save a Meta Pixel ID (and optionally a Conversion API token). Browser events and server events (ViewContent, AddToCart, Purchase) use the same product IDs as your catalogs. GDPR mode is on by default and pauses pixels until a consent plugin allows them (fspf_pixels_allowed filter) or you turn GDPR mode off.

Data sent when a visitor views a product, adds to cart, or completes a WooCommerce order (and pixels are allowed): Pixel ID, hashed email when available, IP address, user agent, page URL, event name, and product content IDs.

Service: Meta. Terms · Privacy Policy

TikTok Pixel and Events API (optional)

Used only if you save a TikTok Pixel ID (and optionally an Events API token). Same consent rules as Meta pixels.

Data sent for the same WooCommerce events: Pixel ID, hashed email when available, IP address, user agent, page URL, event name, and product content IDs.

Service: TikTok. Terms of Service · Privacy Policy · Events API

Optional OAuth bridge

If you enter an OAuth bridge URL in Settings (or define FSPF_OAUTH_BRIDGE), Connect buttons send the visitor to that host so they can log in with the platform. The plugin sends the platform name, a one-time state nonce, your site URL, and the admin return URL. The host returns an access token to your WordPress admin. Leave this empty to paste tokens yourself. Only use a host you trust; that host’s own terms and privacy policy apply.

Pinterest and Snapchat catalogs

Catalog files are generated on your WordPress site from WooCommerce. This plugin does not call Pinterest or Snapchat APIs. You paste the file URL into those products yourself.

Pinterest: Terms · Privacy

Snapchat: Terms · Privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/feedliyo-social-product-feed-lite, or install via Plugins → Add New
  2. Activate Feedliyo – Social Feed & Product Feed Lite
  3. Open Feedliyo in the admin menu
  4. Connect Social Accounts, create a feed, embed the shortcode / Gutenberg block / Elementor widget
  5. Optional: create a WooCommerce catalog for Meta or TikTok under Catalogs
sections.faq:
Where can I see a live demo?

Live demos for every network:

  • Instagram
  • Facebook
  • TikTok
  • X
  • YouTube
  • Threads
  • Social Wall (Pro)

Is Feedliyo an Instagram feed plugin?

Yes. Feedliyo includes a full Instagram feed for WordPress (Grid on Lite; more layouts in Pro), plus five other networks in the same plugin.

Does it support Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Threads?

Yes. Lite supports Facebook feed, TikTok feed, YouTube feed, X (Twitter) feed, and Threads feed alongside Instagram — one all-in-one social feed plugin.

Is this a WooCommerce product feed / catalog plugin too?

Yes. Lite generates WooCommerce product catalogs for Meta / Instagram Commerce (XML) and TikTok Catalog (CSV). Pro adds Pinterest and Snapchat catalogs.

How is Feedliyo different from single-network social feed plugins?

Most social feed products ship as separate Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, or Twitter plugins. Feedliyo is all-in-one: six networks in one UI, plus product catalogs for social ads — so you do not maintain a plugin stack for each channel.

Do I need Elementor or Gutenberg?

No. Use the [fspf_feed id="123"] shortcode, a Gutenberg block, or an Elementor widget — whichever your site already uses.

Does Feedliyo scrape Instagram or TikTok?

No. Feedliyo uses official platform APIs with credentials you connect. It does not scrape social sites.

Does Lite include Social Walls, masonry, carousel, or shoppable tags?

Those are Pro features. Lite includes Grid galleries, unlimited accounts, lightbox, six platforms, embeds, and Meta + TikTok catalogs. Pro unlocks advanced layouts, Social Walls, shoppable WooCommerce tags, extra catalogs, pixels, and Import / Export. See a live Social Wall demo.

Are unlimited accounts and lightbox free?

Yes. Unlimited accounts and the lightbox work on both Free and Pro — no upgrade required.

Can I use this for Google Shopping?

No. Google Shopping / Google Merchant Center product feeds are out of scope. Feedliyo focuses on social display feeds and Meta / TikTok / Pinterest / Snapchat catalog channels.

Where do I add custom CSS for the social gallery?

Use WordPress Appearance → Customize → Additional CSS. Feedliyo does not store arbitrary CSS or JavaScript in the plugin settings.

Does this plugin track visitors by default?

No. Social APIs load your connected posts. Advertising pixels stay off until configured (Pro) and GDPR mode can pause them until consent allows them.

Is Pro a separate plugin or a replacement?

Feedliyo Pro is an optional add-on. Keep Lite installed. Pro unlocks premium modules while Lite continues to power the core admin and free features. Get Pro at https://feedliyo.com/.

What shortcodes are available?

Primary shortcode: [fspf_feed id="1"]. Legacy aliases such as [esfl_feed] may also work. Pro adds Social Wall shortcodes when the Pro add-on is active.
sections.changelog:
1.0.21

  • Live demos for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, YouTube, Threads, and Social Wall (header, dashboard, How To, readme).
  • Lite Import / Export and Social Walls screens show a Pro UI preview teaser with Upgrade CTA.
  • Free vs Pro table and readme highlight Unlimited accounts and Lightbox (included on Free).
  • Header Docs link temporarily points to https://feedliyo.com/.
  • Readme tags: instagram feed, tiktok feed, youtube feed, facebook feed, product feed.

1.0.20

  • WordPress.org release: USP-focused readme, screenshots, and Pro upgrade link (https://feedliyo.com/).
  • Catalog edit screen matches the Feedliyo admin UI; Pro locks for Pinterest, Snapchat, and social-only filters.
  • Dashboard Free vs Pro table includes Social Walls, Import / Export, and Playlist.
  • Avoid double admin header when Feedliyo Pro owns Social Walls menus.

1.0.19

  • Phase 4: Harden Pro gates — fspf_is_pro() requires registered Pro modules; UI locks use fspf_pro_module_active( ‘layouts’ ).
  • Dashboard Free vs Pro table updated for Social Walls, Import / Export, and Playlist.

1.0.18

  • Phase 3: Pro-only layout partials (list, highlight, playlist card, stories) moved to Pro. Lite defaults to Grid only unless Pro expands fspf_allowed_layouts.

1.0.17

  • Phase 2: Import / Export tools moved to the Pro add-on. Lite keeps an upgrade stub.

1.0.16

  • Phase 1: Social Wall implementation moved to the Pro add-on. Lite keeps upgrade stubs and channel feeds.

1.0.15

  • Phase 0 Pro contracts: fspf_allowed_layouts(), fspf_pro_module_active(), fspf_locate_template() for the Pro add-on.

1.0.1

  • Initial directory submission under the Feedliyo – Social Feed & Product Feed Lite name.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
